crossRefs.note: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may…
Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know…
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I…
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have…
For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

parallels.note: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

translations.web: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
translations.bsb: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.”
translations.kjv: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
translations.asv: And he said, If now I have found favor in thy sight, O Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in the midst of us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
